title: Review (read-only) the uncommitted changes in the git worktree /home/n3o/code/aura-harness/.worktrees/channel-projects …
summary: I reviewed the diff by reading files and using grep/git only; I did not run cargo, so nothing here was checked against a build. The project-removal guard works as intended. The main problems are a coordinator that keeps working in its old folder after a project change, and members (and their counts) left under the old project after a switch.
